items.question: Trong câu "BA skill lists are usually long enough to alarm newcomers.", từ "alarm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA skill lists are usually long enough to alarm newcomers.", what does "alarm" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make someone worried or afraid
items.explanation: alarm /əˈlɑːrm/ (động từ): làm lo lắng, hoảng sợ. Danh từ "alarm" còn có nghĩa là chuông báo động; "alarming" = đáng lo ngại.
items.explanationEn: alarm /əˈlɑːrm/ (verb): to make someone worried or afraid. As a noun, "alarm" also means a warning bell; "alarming" means worrying.

items.question: Trong câu "BA skill lists are usually long enough to alarm newcomers.", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA skill lists are usually long enough to alarm newcomers.", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: someone who has left a job
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnuːkʌmər/ (danh từ): người mới vào nghề. "Newcomers to the field" = người mới bước vào lĩnh vực; gần nghĩa với "beginner".
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnuːkʌmər/ (noun): someone recently arrived. "Newcomers to the field" are people new to it; a close synonym is "beginner".

items.question: Trong câu "Reorganise them into three tiers by how foundational they are:", từ "tier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reorganise them into three tiers by how foundational they are:", what does "tier" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tier /tɪr/ (danh từ): tầng, cấp bậc. Hay gặp trong "three-tier architecture" (kiến trúc ba tầng) hoặc "pricing tier" (gói giá). Đừng nhầm với "tear".
items.explanationEn: tier /tɪr/ (noun): a level in a ranking. Common in "three-tier architecture" or "pricing tier". Do not confuse it with "tear".

items.question: Trong câu "Reorganise them into three tiers by how foundational they are:", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reorganise them into three tiers by how foundational they are:", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪʃənl/ (tính từ): nền tảng, cơ bản. Gốc từ "foundation" (nền móng); "foundational skills" = kỹ năng nền tảng.
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪʃənl/ (adjective): forming the base. From "foundation"; "foundational skills" are the ones everything else builds on.

items.question: Trong câu "Tier 1 — Core skills (indispensable).", từ "indispensable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tier 1 — Core skills (indispensable).", what does "indispensable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: indispensable /ˌɪndɪˈspensəbl/ (tính từ): không thể thiếu. Trái nghĩa với "dispensable" (có thể bỏ đi); "an indispensable tool" = công cụ không thể thiếu.
items.explanationEn: indispensable /ˌɪndɪˈspensəbl/ (adjective): absolutely necessary. The opposite of "dispensable"; "an indispensable tool" is one you cannot work without.

items.question: Trong câu "Tier 2 — Craft skills (learnable).", từ "craft" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tier 2 — Craft skills (learnable).", what does "craft" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: craft /kræft/ (danh từ): tay nghề, nghề thủ công. "Craft" chỉ kỹ năng nghề học được qua thực hành; nghĩa khác là tàu, thuyền (aircraft, spacecraft).
items.explanationEn: craft /kræft/ (noun): a practical trade skill. "Craft" is a skill learned through practice; another sense is a vessel, as in aircraft or spacecraft.

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation techniques, modeling, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, SQL, reading APIs.", từ "elicitation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation techniques, modeling, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, SQL, reading APIs.", what does "elicitation" (noun) mean?
options: khơi gợi, thu thập thông tin
items.explanation: elicitation /iˌlɪsɪˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): khơi gợi, thu thập thông tin. Động từ "elicit" = khơi ra; "requirements elicitation" = thu thập yêu cầu từ stakeholder.
items.explanationEn: elicitation /iˌlɪsɪˈteɪʃn/ (noun): drawing out information. The verb is "elicit"; "requirements elicitation" means drawing requirements out of stakeholders.

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation techniques, modeling, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, SQL, reading APIs.", từ "acceptance criteria" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation techniques, modeling, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, SQL, reading APIs.", what does "acceptance criteria" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: acceptance criteria /əkˈseptəns kraɪˈtɪriə/ (cụm từ): tiêu chí nghiệm thu. "Criteria" là số nhiều của "criterion"; mỗi user story nên có acceptance criteria rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: acceptance criteria /əkˈseptəns kraɪˈtɪriə/ (phrase): conditions for accepting work. "Criteria" is the plural of "criterion"; every user story should carry clear acceptance criteria.

items.question: Trong câu "Tier 3 — Contextual skills (accumulated).", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tier 3 — Contextual skills (accumulated).", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (động từ): tích lũy dần. "Accumulate experience" = tích lũy kinh nghiệm; kỹ năng tầng 3 chỉ có qua thời gian.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (verb): to build up over time. "Accumulate experience" means building it up over time; tier-3 skills only come that way.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge, organizational awareness, negotiation, relationship building.", từ "awareness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge, organizational awareness, negotiation, relationship building.", what does "awareness" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a feeling of worry or unease
items.explanation: awareness /əˈwernəs/ (danh từ): sự hiểu biết, nhận thức. "Organizational awareness" = hiểu cách tổ chức vận hành (ai quyết định, ai ảnh hưởng). Tính từ: aware.
items.explanationEn: awareness /əˈwernəs/ (noun): understanding of a situation. "Organizational awareness" is knowing how the organisation really works. Adjective: aware.

items.question: Trong câu "No shortcuts here.", từ "shortcut" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No shortcuts here.", what does "shortcut" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a quicker way to reach a goal
items.explanation: shortcut /ˈʃɔːrtkʌt/ (danh từ): lối tắt, cách làm nhanh. Ở đây là nghĩa bóng: không có đường tắt; nghĩa khác trong tin học là phím tắt (keyboard shortcut).
items.explanationEn: shortcut /ˈʃɔːrtkʌt/ (noun): a quicker way to reach a goal. Figurative here: there is no quick route; in computing it also means a keyboard shortcut.

items.question: Trong câu "Newcomers usually invest backwards: they learn tools and document templates (tier 2) first and skip tier 1.", từ "invest" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Newcomers usually invest backwards: they learn tools and document templates (tier 2) first and skip tier 1.", what does "invest" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invest /ɪnˈvest/ (động từ): dồn công sức, đầu tư. "Invest time/effort in something" = bỏ thời gian, công sức vào việc gì; không chỉ dùng cho tiền.
items.explanationEn: invest /ɪnˈvest/ (verb): to put effort into. "Invest time or effort in something" is common; the verb is not limited to money.

items.question: Trong câu "Newcomers usually invest backwards: they learn tools and document templates (tier 2) first and skip tier 1.", từ "template" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Newcomers usually invest backwards: they learn tools and document templates (tier 2) first and skip tier 1.", what does "template" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: template /ˈtemplət/ (danh từ): mẫu (tài liệu) có sẵn. "Document template" = biểu mẫu tài liệu; dùng template không thay được việc hỏi đúng câu hỏi.
items.explanationEn: template /ˈtemplət/ (noun): a ready-made pattern. "Document template" is a reusable layout; using one does not replace asking the right questions.

items.question: Trong câu "The result is documentation in the right format with hollow content, because they never asked the right questions.", từ "hollow" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is documentation in the right format with hollow content, because they never asked the right questions.", what does "hollow" (adjective) mean?
options: dài dòng, lan man khó theo
lỗi thời, cũ kỹ không dùng
items.explanation: hollow /ˈhɑːloʊ/ (tính từ): rỗng tuếch, thiếu thực chất. Nghĩa đen là rỗng ruột (a hollow tree); nghĩa bóng "hollow content" = nội dung không có giá trị thật.
items.explanationEn: hollow /ˈhɑːloʊ/ (adjective): lacking real substance. Literally "empty inside" (a hollow tree); figuratively, "hollow content" has no real value.

items.question: Trong câu "The quality of the requirements you write is capped by the quality of the questions you asked.", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The quality of the requirements you write is capped by the quality of the questions you asked.", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): giới hạn mức tối đa. "Be capped by/at" = bị giới hạn trên bởi; danh từ "cap" = mức trần (a spending cap).
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Be capped by/at" means limited to a maximum; the noun "cap" is a ceiling, as in a spending cap.

items.question: Trong câu "you just planted that idea rather than discovering the real need.", từ "plant" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you just planted that idea rather than discovering the real need.", what does "plant" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a seed in the ground
to put an idea in a mind
items.explanation: plant /plænt/ (động từ): gieo (ý tưởng) vào đầu. "Plant an idea" = gieo ý tưởng, khiến người dùng trả lời theo gợi ý của bạn thay vì nói nhu cầu thật.
items.explanationEn: plant /plænt/ (verb): to put an idea in a mind. "Plant an idea" means suggesting it so the user echoes you instead of revealing their real need.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask why repeatedly, going one layer deeper each time:", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask why repeatedly, going one layer deeper each time:", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiːtɪdli/ (trạng từ): lặp đi lặp lại. Kỹ thuật hỏi "why" nhiều lần (5 Whys) giúp đào tới gốc rễ vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiːtɪdli/ (adverb): again and again. Asking "why" repeatedly (the 5 Whys technique) digs down to the root cause.

items.question: Trong câu "The real need was not an Excel button but a process being done by hand every day.", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The real need was not an Excel button but a process being done by hand every day.", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (cụm từ): làm thủ công. "Done by hand" = làm thủ công; việc thủ công lặp lại hằng ngày thường là cơ hội tự động hóa.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (phrase): manually. "Done by hand" means manually; a daily manual task is often a chance to automate.

items.question: Trong câu "catches exception cases.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "catches exception cases.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsepʃn/ (danh từ): trường hợp ngoại lệ. "Exception case" = trường hợp ngoại lệ; trong lập trình "exception" còn là đối tượng lỗi được ném ra.
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsepʃn/ (noun): a case outside the rule. "Exception case" is one outside the normal rule; in programming it also means a thrown error.

items.question: Trong câu ""Who else is involved in this?" — catches overlooked stakeholders.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Who else is involved in this?" — catches overlooked stakeholders.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
options: bỏ sót, không để ý tới
optionsEn: to look down on from above
items.explanation: overlook /ˌoʊvərˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý tới. "Overlooked stakeholders" = các bên liên quan bị bỏ sót; nghĩa khác: có tầm nhìn xuống (a room overlooking the sea).
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌoʊvərˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Overlooked stakeholders" are ones nobody noticed; another sense is to have a view over (a room overlooking the sea).

items.question: Trong câu "catches workarounds, each of which is an unmet requirement.", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "catches workarounds, each of which is an unmet requirement.", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜːrkəraʊnd/ (danh từ): cách xoay xở tạm thời. "Workaround" là cách người dùng tự lách khi hệ thống thiếu tính năng; mỗi workaround là một yêu cầu chưa được đáp ứng.
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜːrkəraʊnd/ (noun): a temporary way around. A workaround is how users get by when the system falls short; each one hides an unmet requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "catches workarounds, each of which is an unmet requirement.", từ "unmet" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "catches workarounds, each of which is an unmet requirement.", what does "unmet" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (tính từ): chưa được đáp ứng. "Unmet need/requirement" = nhu cầu/yêu cầu chưa được đáp ứng; động từ gốc "meet a requirement".
items.explanationEn: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (adjective): not yet satisfied. "Unmet need/requirement" is one not yet satisfied; it comes from "meet a requirement".

items.question: Trong câu "Listening is not staying silent while waiting for your turn.", từ "silent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Listening is not staying silent while waiting for your turn.", what does "silent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: silent /ˈsaɪlənt/ (tính từ): im lặng. "Stay silent" = giữ im lặng; "be silent about something" = không nhắc gì đến điều gì.
items.explanationEn: silent /ˈsaɪlənt/ (adjective): not speaking. "Stay silent" means not speaking; "be silent about something" means not mentioning it.

items.question: Trong câu "Three concrete techniques:", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three concrete techniques:", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɑːŋkriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Concrete example/technique" = ví dụ/kỹ thuật cụ thể; trái nghĩa "abstract". Danh từ "concrete" = bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɑːŋkriːt/ (adjective): specific and definite. "Concrete example/technique" means specific; the opposite is "abstract". As a noun it means cement mix.

items.question: Trong câu "When you paraphrase and the other person says", từ "paraphrase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you paraphrase and the other person says", what does "paraphrase" (verb) mean?
options: diễn đạt lại bằng lời mình
optionsEn: to restate in your own words
items.explanation: paraphrase /ˈpærəfreɪz/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại bằng lời mình. Nhắc lại ý người kia bằng lời của mình để xác nhận đã hiểu đúng; khác "quote" (trích nguyên văn).
items.explanationEn: paraphrase /ˈpærəfreɪz/ (verb): to restate in your own words. You restate what someone said in your own words to confirm understanding; unlike "quote", which is verbatim.

items.question: Trong câu "you have just caught an ambiguity before it became wrong code.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you have just caught an ambiguity before it became wrong code.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. Tính từ "ambiguous" = mơ hồ; bắt được ambiguity sớm rẻ hơn nhiều so với sửa code sai.
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæmbɪˈɡjuːəti/ (noun): unclear double meaning. Adjective: "ambiguous"; catching an ambiguity early is far cheaper than fixing wrong code.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not write continuously.", từ "continuously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not write continuously.", what does "continuously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: continuously /kənˈtɪnjuəsli/ (trạng từ): liên tục không ngừng. "Continuously" = liên tục không ngắt; ghi chép liền mạch khó dùng lại, nên chia theo cấu trúc.
items.explanationEn: continuously /kənˈtɪnjuəsli/ (adverb): without stopping. "Continuously" means without a break; unbroken notes are hard to reuse, so structure them.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (danh từ): giả định (chưa kiểm chứng). "Make an assumption" = đưa ra giả định; BA luôn tách giả định khỏi sự thật đã xác nhận.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (noun): a belief not yet proven. "Make an assumption" is the usual collocation; a BA keeps assumptions apart from confirmed facts.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: verify /ˈverɪfaɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng. Danh từ "verification"; "verify an assumption" = kiểm chứng giả định.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈverɪfaɪ/ (verb): to check it is true. Noun: "verification"; "verify an assumption" means checking whether it holds.

items.question: Trong câu "That structure turns notes into direct input for your documentation.", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That structure turns notes into direct input for your documentation.", what does "input" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: input /ˈɪnpʊt/ (danh từ): đầu vào. Ở đây là nguyên liệu cho tài liệu; "input" còn có nghĩa ý kiến đóng góp (thanks for your input).
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪnpʊt/ (noun): material fed into a process. Here it is raw material for the document; it can also mean advice or comments ("thanks for your input").

items.question: Trong câu "If someone describes the happy path in great detail but is silent about failure cases, that is a sign nobody has considered them — and you should ask.", từ "happy path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If someone describes the happy path in great detail but is silent about failure cases, that is a sign nobody has considered them — and you should ask.", what does "happy path" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: happy path /ˈhæpi pæθ/ (cụm từ): luồng chạy không lỗi. "Happy path" là kịch bản mọi thứ diễn ra như mong đợi; đối lập với "failure cases" hay "edge cases".
items.explanationEn: happy path /ˈhæpi pæθ/ (phrase): the error-free flow. The "happy path" is the scenario where everything goes as expected; contrast "failure cases" or "edge cases".

items.question: Trong câu "If someone describes the happy path in great detail but is silent about failure cases, that is a sign nobody has considered them — and you should ask.", từ "in great detail" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If someone describes the happy path in great detail but is silent about failure cases, that is a sign nobody has considered them — and you should ask.", what does "in great detail" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in great detail /ɪn ɡreɪt ˈdiːteɪl/ (cụm từ): rất tỉ mỉ. "Describe/explain in great detail" = mô tả rất chi tiết; tương tự "in depth".
items.explanationEn: in great detail /ɪn ɡreɪt ˈdiːteɪl/ (phrase): very thoroughly. "Describe/explain in great detail" means very thoroughly; similar to "in depth".

items.question: Trong câu "Analytical thinking is the ability to break a large vague problem into tractable parts and see the relationships between them.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analytical thinking is the ability to break a large vague problem into tractable parts and see the relationships between them.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "A vague requirement" = yêu cầu mơ hồ; trạng từ "vaguely".
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear. "A vague requirement" is one without a clear meaning; adverb: "vaguely".

items.question: Trong câu "Analytical thinking is the ability to break a large vague problem into tractable parts and see the relationships between them.", từ "tractable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analytical thinking is the ability to break a large vague problem into tractable parts and see the relationships between them.", what does "tractable" (adjective) mean?
options: dễ xử lý, kiểm soát được
items.explanation: tractable /ˈtræktəbl/ (tính từ): dễ xử lý, kiểm soát được. "Tractable" = xử lý được; trái nghĩa "intractable" (nan giải). Đừng nhầm với "trackable".
items.explanationEn: tractable /ˈtræktəbl/ (adjective): easy to manage. "Tractable" means manageable; the opposite is "intractable". Do not confuse it with "trackable".

items.question: Trong câu "Separate problem from symptom.", từ "symptom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate problem from symptom.", what does "symptom" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a visible sign of an issue
items.explanation: symptom /ˈsɪmptəm/ (danh từ): biểu hiện bề ngoài. Mượn từ y học; "treat the symptom, not the cause" = chữa phần ngọn thay vì gốc.
items.explanationEn: symptom /ˈsɪmptəm/ (noun): a visible sign of an issue. Borrowed from medicine; "treating the symptom, not the cause" means fixing the surface only.

items.question: Trong câu "The cause may be a confusing form, missing validation, or a process that forces them to rush.", từ "validation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cause may be a confusing form, missing validation, or a process that forces them to rush.", what does "validation" (noun) mean?
options: kiểm tra hợp lệ dữ liệu
items.explanation: validation /ˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): kiểm tra hợp lệ dữ liệu. "Input validation" = kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập; nghĩa đời thường là sự công nhận (seek validation).
items.explanationEn: validation /ˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): checking that input is valid. "Input validation" checks entered data; in everyday use it can mean approval from others ("seek validation").

items.question: Trong câu "The cause may be a confusing form, missing validation, or a process that forces them to rush.", từ "rush" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cause may be a confusing form, missing validation, or a process that forces them to rush.", what does "rush" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rush /rʌʃ/ (động từ): làm vội vàng. "Be forced to rush" = bị ép làm vội; "rush hour" = giờ cao điểm.
items.explanationEn: rush /rʌʃ/ (verb): to do something too quickly. "Be forced to rush" means having to hurry; "rush hour" is peak traffic time.

items.question: Trong câu "Exceptions are where the real complexity lives.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exceptions are where the real complexity lives.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp. Tính từ "complex"; ngoại lệ thường là nơi chứa phần phức tạp thật sự.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (noun): how complicated it is. Adjective: "complex"; exceptions are usually where the real complexity hides.

items.question: Trong câu "Verify instead of assuming.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Verify instead of assuming.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsuːm/ (động từ): cho là đúng. Ở đây là giả định; nghĩa khác "assume responsibility/a role" = đảm nhận trách nhiệm/vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsuːm/ (verb): to suppose without proof. Here it means supposing; another sense is "assume responsibility/a role", i.e. take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "run a query and see what percentage of records actually have one.", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "run a query and see what percentage of records actually have one.", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrekərd/ (danh từ): bản ghi (dữ liệu). Danh từ "record" /ˈrekərd/ = bản ghi; động từ "record" /rɪˈkɔːrd/ = ghi lại.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrekərd/ (noun): one entry of stored data. Noun "record" /ˈrekərd/ is a data entry; the verb /rɪˈkɔːrd/ means to write down or capture.

items.question: Trong câu "The test for analytical thinking is simple: given one requirement sentence, can you produce at least five clarifying questions?", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The test for analytical thinking is simple: given one requirement sentence, can you produce at least five clarifying questions?", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarifying question" = câu hỏi làm rõ; danh từ "clarification".
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (verb): to make clearer. A "clarifying question" removes doubt about meaning; noun: "clarification".

items.question: Trong câu "If not, you are accepting information at surface level.", từ "at surface level" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If not, you are accepting information at surface level.", what does "at surface level" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at surface level /æt ˈsɜːrfɪs ˈlevl/ (cụm từ): một cách hời hợt. "At surface level" = chỉ ở bề mặt; tương tự "superficially", trái nghĩa "in depth".
items.explanationEn: at surface level /æt ˈsɜːrfɪs ˈlevl/ (phrase): superficially. "At surface level" means without looking deeper; similar to "superficially", opposite "in depth".

items.question: Trong câu "A great many software project problems are really language problems.", từ "a great many" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many software project problems are really language problems.", what does "a great many" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmeni/ (cụm từ): rất nhiều. "A great many + danh từ số nhiều" = rất nhiều; trang trọng hơn "a lot of".
items.explanationEn: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmeni/ (phrase): very many. "A great many" + plural noun means very many; more formal than "a lot of".

items.question: Trong câu "One ambiguous sentence can cost weeks of rework.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One ambiguous sentence can cost weeks of rework.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. Danh từ "ambiguity"; một câu yêu cầu mơ hồ có thể gây nhiều tuần làm lại.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): open to several readings. Noun: "ambiguity"; one ambiguous requirement can cause weeks of rework.

items.question: Trong câu "One ambiguous sentence can cost weeks of rework.", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One ambiguous sentence can cost weeks of rework.", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriːwɜːrk/ (danh từ): việc phải làm lại. "Cost weeks of rework" = tốn nhiều tuần làm lại; rework là chi phí ẩn lớn của yêu cầu kém.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriːwɜːrk/ (noun): work redone to fix errors. "Cost weeks of rework" is a typical phrase; rework is a major hidden cost of poor requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "1. Write in the active voice, naming who does what.", từ "active voice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "1. Write in the active voice, naming who does what.", what does "active voice" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: grammar where the subject is acted on
items.explanation: active voice /ˈæktɪv vɔɪs/ (cụm từ): thể chủ động (ngữ pháp). Câu chủ động nêu rõ chủ thể: "The system updates..." thay vì bị động "... will be updated".
items.explanationEn: active voice /ˈæktɪv vɔɪs/ (phrase): grammar where the subject acts. Active voice names the actor: "The system updates..." rather than the passive "... will be updated".

items.question: Trong câu "The system updates the serial number when Fulfillment confirms shipment", từ "shipment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system updates the serial number when Fulfillment confirms shipment", what does "shipment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shipment /ˈʃɪpmənt/ (danh từ): việc gửi hàng đi. Gốc "ship" = gửi hàng (không chỉ bằng tàu); "confirm shipment" = xác nhận đã gửi hàng.
items.explanationEn: shipment /ˈʃɪpmənt/ (noun): the sending of goods. From "ship", meaning to send goods by any means; "confirm shipment" means confirming goods were sent.

items.question: Trong câu "each must be translated into a measurable characteristic.", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "each must be translated into a measurable characteristic.", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. Yêu cầu tốt phải đo được, ví dụ "fast" → "phản hồi dưới 2 giây".
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (adjective): able to be measured. Good requirements are measurable, e.g. "fast" becomes "responds within 2 seconds".

items.question: Trong câu "each must be translated into a measurable characteristic.", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "each must be translated into a measurable characteristic.", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: translate /trænzˈleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển thành (dạng khác). "Translate X into Y" ở đây là chuyển một từ mơ hồ thành chỉ tiêu cụ thể, không phải dịch ngôn ngữ.
items.explanationEn: translate /trænzˈleɪt/ (verb): to convert into another form. "Translate X into Y" here means converting a vague word into a concrete measure, not changing language.

items.question: Trong câu "usually signal you have merged two requirements into one sentence.", từ "signal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "usually signal you have merged two requirements into one sentence.", what does "signal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (động từ): báo hiệu, cho thấy. "Signal that..." = là dấu hiệu cho thấy; danh từ "signal" = tín hiệu.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (verb): to indicate. "Signal that..." means to be a sign of something; as a noun, "signal" is a transmitted sign.

items.question: Trong câu "usually signal you have merged two requirements into one sentence.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "usually signal you have merged two requirements into one sentence.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːrdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại làm một. "Merge A and B into one" = gộp; lập trình viên cũng hay nói "merge a branch".
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːrdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge A and B into one" means combining them; developers also "merge a branch".

items.question: Trong câu "A sample payload or an example data table removes ambiguity faster than any paragraph of prose.", từ "prose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sample payload or an example data table removes ambiguity faster than any paragraph of prose.", what does "prose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prose /proʊz/ (danh từ): văn xuôi. "Paragraph of prose" = đoạn văn diễn giải; ví dụ cụ thể thường rõ hơn văn xuôi.
items.explanationEn: prose /proʊz/ (noun): ordinary written text. "A paragraph of prose" is plain descriptive text; a concrete example is often clearer.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", từ "ludicrous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", what does "ludicrous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ludicrous /ˈluːdɪkrəs/ (tính từ): lố bịch, vô lý. Đồng nghĩa "absurd", "ridiculous"; nghĩ ra cách hiểu lố bịch giúp phát hiện câu viết lỏng lẻo.
items.explanationEn: ludicrous /ˈluːdɪkrəs/ (adjective): absurd, ridiculous. Synonyms: "absurd", "ridiculous"; inventing a ludicrous reading exposes loosely written sentences.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", từ "literally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", what does "literally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: literally /ˈlɪtərəli/ (trạng từ): theo nghĩa đen. "Literally compliant" = tuân thủ đúng từng chữ nhưng sai tinh thần; trái nghĩa "figuratively".
items.explanationEn: literally /ˈlɪtərəli/ (adverb): word for word. "Literally compliant" means obeying the exact words while missing the intent; opposite "figuratively".

items.question: Trong câu "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", từ "compliant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", what does "compliant" (adjective) mean?
options: tuân thủ, đáp ứng quy định
items.explanation: compliant /kəmˈplaɪənt/ (tính từ): tuân thủ, đáp ứng quy định. Danh từ "compliance" (sự tuân thủ); đừng nhầm với "complain" (phàn nàn).
items.explanationEn: compliant /kəmˈplaɪənt/ (adjective): conforming to a rule. Noun: "compliance"; do not confuse it with "complain".

items.question: Trong câu "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", từ "interpretation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-check: reread the requirement and invent a ludicrous but literally compliant interpretation.", what does "interpretation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interpretation /ɪnˌtɜːrprɪˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): cách hiểu, cách diễn giải. Động từ "interpret"; một câu yêu cầu tốt chỉ nên có một cách hiểu.
items.explanationEn: interpretation /ɪnˌtɜːrprɪˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a way of understanding. Verb: "interpret"; a good requirement should allow only one interpretation.

items.question: Trong câu "Short, lead with the conclusion, back it with numbers", từ "lead with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Short, lead with the conclusion, back it with numbers", what does "lead with" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to be head of a team
items.explanation: lead with /liːd wɪð/ (cụm từ): mở đầu bằng. "Lead with the conclusion" = nói kết luận trước; lãnh đạo muốn nghe điều quan trọng nhất ngay đầu.
items.explanationEn: lead with /liːd wɪð/ (phrase): to start with. "Lead with the conclusion" means stating it first; executives want the key point up front.

items.question: Trong câu "Business language, concrete examples, avoid IT jargon", từ "jargon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business language, concrete examples, avoid IT jargon", what does "jargon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: jargon /ˈdʒɑːrɡən/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ chuyên ngành. "Avoid jargon" = tránh dùng thuật ngữ chuyên môn khi nói với người ngoài ngành.
items.explanationEn: jargon /ˈdʒɑːrɡən/ (noun): insider technical terms. "Avoid jargon" means not using insider terms with people outside the field.

items.question: Trong câu "Negotiation in BA work is rarely about money — it is about scope and ordering.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Negotiation in BA work is rarely about money — it is about scope and ordering.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skoʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi (công việc). "Project scope" = phạm vi dự án; "out of scope" = nằm ngoài phạm vi. Nghĩa khác: kính ngắm (telescope).
items.explanationEn: scope /skoʊp/ (noun): the extent of work covered. "Project scope" is what the project covers; "out of scope" is excluded. Also a viewing instrument, as in telescope.

items.question: Trong câu "Never say a bare no.", từ "bare" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never say a bare no.", what does "bare" (adjective) mean?
options: trơ trọi, không kèm gì thêm
items.explanation: bare /ber/ (tính từ): trơ trọi, không kèm gì thêm. "A bare no" = lời từ chối trơ trọi, không kèm phương án; nghĩa khác "bare feet" = chân trần.
items.explanationEn: bare /ber/ (adjective): plain, nothing added. "A bare no" is a refusal with no alternative offered; another sense is "bare feet", i.e. uncovered.

items.question: Trong câu "if we add this then that moves to the next release", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "if we add this then that moves to the next release", what does "release" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): bản phát hành (phần mềm). "Next release" = bản phát hành kế tiếp; "press release" = thông cáo báo chí.
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): a software version. "The next release" is the next shipped version; a "press release" is a media statement.

items.question: Trong câu "The last three projects averaged seven weeks of rework from missed requirements", từ "average" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The last three projects averaged seven weeks of rework from missed requirements", what does "average" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to have as a mean value
items.explanation: average /ˈævərɪdʒ/ (động từ): trung bình đạt. Động từ "average X" = trung bình đạt X; danh từ "on average" = tính trung bình.
items.explanationEn: average /ˈævərɪdʒ/ (verb): to have as a mean value. The verb "average X" means the mean comes to X; "on average" is the matching phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluate the requirement, not the person who raised it.", từ "evaluate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluate the requirement, not the person who raised it.", what does "evaluate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (động từ): đánh giá, thẩm định. Danh từ "evaluation"; đánh giá yêu cầu dựa trên giá trị, không dựa vào người đề xuất.
items.explanationEn: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (verb): to judge the value of. Noun: "evaluation"; judge a requirement on its merits, not on who proposed it.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluate the requirement, not the person who raised it.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluate the requirement, not the person who raised it.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra, đề xuất. "Raise an issue/a requirement" = nêu ra vấn đề/yêu cầu; nghĩa khác "raise prices" = tăng giá.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise an issue/a requirement" means bringing it up; another sense is "raise prices".

items.question: Trong câu "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", từ "sharp" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", what does "sharp" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sharp /ʃɑːrp/ (tính từ): sắc bén, trúng trọng tâm. "Sharp question" = câu hỏi sắc bén; nghĩa khác "a sharp knife" (dao sắc), "a sharp drop" (giảm đột ngột).
items.explanationEn: sharp /ʃɑːrp/ (adjective): incisive, to the point. "A sharp question" is incisive; other senses: "a sharp knife", "a sharp drop" (sudden).

items.question: Trong câu "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɑːt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. "Spot a problem/an error" = phát hiện vấn đề/lỗi; danh từ "spot" = chỗ, vết.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɑːt/ (verb): to notice or detect. "Spot a problem/an error" means noticing it; the noun "spot" is a place or a mark.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", từ "hidden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA need not write production code but needs enough understanding to ask sharp questions and spot hidden work.", what does "hidden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hidden /ˈhɪdn/ (tính từ): ẩn, không dễ thấy. Quá khứ phân từ của "hide"; "hidden work/cost" = khối lượng/chi phí ẩn.
items.explanationEn: hidden /ˈhɪdn/ (adjective): not easily seen. Past participle of "hide"; "hidden work/cost" is effort or cost that is not obvious.

items.question: Trong câu "Enough to read the Network tab and tell whether a defect sits in the UI or the data.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enough to read the Network tab and tell whether a defect sits in the UI or the data.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: leaving to join the other side
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Defect" gần nghĩa "bug"; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ = đào tẩu, bỏ phe.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. "Defect" is close to "bug"; the verb /dɪˈfekt/ means to desert to another side.

items.question: Trong câu "Databases and SQL — tables, relationships, keys; able to write basic filtering and aggregation queries.", từ "aggregation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Databases and SQL — tables, relationships, keys; able to write basic filtering and aggregation queries.", what does "aggregation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: aggregation /ˌæɡrɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (danh từ): tổng hợp dữ liệu. Truy vấn aggregation dùng SUM, COUNT, GROUP BY; động từ "aggregate".
items.explanationEn: aggregation /ˌæɡrɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (noun): grouping data into totals. Aggregation queries use SUM, COUNT or GROUP BY; verb: "aggregate".

items.question: Trong câu "Layered architecture — knowing whether a change touches the interface, the business layer, or the data layer, because the ripple differs enormously.", từ "ripple" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Layered architecture — knowing whether a change touches the interface, the business layer, or the data layer, because the ripple differs enormously.", what does "ripple" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (danh từ): tác động lan tỏa. "Ripple effect" = hiệu ứng lan tỏa; nghĩa đen là gợn sóng nhỏ trên mặt nước.
items.explanationEn: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (noun): a spreading effect. "Ripple effect" is a spreading consequence; literally a ripple is a small wave on water.

items.question: Trong câu "Layered architecture — knowing whether a change touches the interface, the business layer, or the data layer, because the ripple differs enormously.", từ "enormously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Layered architecture — knowing whether a change touches the interface, the business layer, or the data layer, because the ripple differs enormously.", what does "enormously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: enormously /ɪˈnɔːrməsli/ (trạng từ): cực kỳ, rất nhiều. Tính từ "enormous" = khổng lồ; "differ enormously" = khác nhau rất lớn.
items.explanationEn: enormously /ɪˈnɔːrməsli/ (adverb): hugely. Adjective: "enormous"; "differ enormously" means differ hugely.

items.question: Trong câu "The development process — dev, test, staging, and production environments and the life cycle of a change.", từ "life cycle" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The development process — dev, test, staging, and production environments and the life cycle of a change.", what does "life cycle" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: life cycle /ˈlaɪf saɪkl/ (cụm từ): vòng đời. "Life cycle of a change" = các giai đoạn một thay đổi đi qua từ dev tới production.
items.explanationEn: life cycle /ˈlaɪf saɪkl/ (phrase): the stages start to end. "The life cycle of a change" is every stage it passes through from dev to production.

items.question: Trong câu "you understand why that costs more than a UI tweak — and can ask the right follow-up.", từ "tweak" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you understand why that costs more than a UI tweak — and can ask the right follow-up.", what does "tweak" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tweak /twiːk/ (danh từ): chỉnh sửa nhỏ. "A small tweak" = chỉnh nhẹ; động từ "tweak the settings" = tinh chỉnh cài đặt.
items.explanationEn: tweak /twiːk/ (noun): a small adjustment. "A small tweak" is a minor change; as a verb, "tweak the settings" means fine-tune them.

items.question: Trong câu "you understand why that costs more than a UI tweak — and can ask the right follow-up.", từ "follow-up" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you understand why that costs more than a UI tweak — and can ask the right follow-up.", what does "follow-up" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: follow-up /ˈfɑːloʊ ʌp/ (danh từ): câu hỏi/việc tiếp nối. Danh từ "follow-up" viết có gạch nối; cụm động từ "follow up on something" viết rời.
items.explanationEn: follow-up /ˈfɑːloʊ ʌp/ (noun): a further question or action. The noun "follow-up" is hyphenated; the phrasal verb "follow up on something" is not.

items.question: Trong câu "Soft skills sound abstract, but each has a concrete exercise:", từ "abstract" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Soft skills sound abstract, but each has a concrete exercise:", what does "abstract" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: abstract /ˈæbstrækt/ (tính từ): trừu tượng. Trái nghĩa "concrete"; danh từ "abstract" = bản tóm tắt (của bài báo khoa học).
items.explanationEn: abstract /ˈæbstrækt/ (adjective): theoretical, vague. Opposite of "concrete"; the noun "abstract" is a summary of a paper.

items.question: Trong câu "After each meeting, rewrite it in your own words and send it back for confirmation", từ "in your own words" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After each meeting, rewrite it in your own words and send it back for confirmation", what does "in your own words" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in your own words /ɪn jʊr oʊn wɜːrdz/ (cụm từ): bằng lời của mình. "Rewrite/explain it in your own words" = diễn đạt lại bằng cách nói của mình, tức là paraphrase.
items.explanationEn: in your own words /ɪn jʊr oʊn wɜːrdz/ (phrase): using your own phrasing. "Rewrite/explain it in your own words" means paraphrasing it yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "After each meeting, rewrite it in your own words and send it back for confirmation", từ "confirmation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After each meeting, rewrite it in your own words and send it back for confirmation", what does "confirmation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a check that it is correct
items.explanation: confirmation /ˌkɑːnfərˈmeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận. Động từ "confirm"; gửi biên bản họp để người tham dự xác nhận là thói quen tốt.
items.explanationEn: confirmation /ˌkɑːnfərˈmeɪʃn/ (noun): a check that it is correct. Verb: "confirm"; sending meeting notes back for confirmation is a good habit.

items.question: Trong câu "Take an everyday process (ordering food, parking) and chart it including every error branch", từ "chart" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Take an everyday process (ordering food, parking) and chart it including every error branch", what does "chart" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: chart /tʃɑːrt/ (động từ): vẽ sơ đồ. "Chart a process" = vẽ sơ đồ quy trình; "charter" (khác từ) = thuê bao chuyến.
items.explanationEn: chart /tʃɑːrt/ (verb): to draw as a diagram. "Chart a process" means drawing it as a diagram; "charter" (a different word) means to hire.

items.question: Trong câu "Take an everyday process (ordering food, parking) and chart it including every error branch", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Take an everyday process (ordering food, parking) and chart it including every error branch", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a path splitting off in a flow
a local office of a company
items.explanation: branch /bræntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh rẽ (luồng xử lý). "Error branch" = nhánh xử lý khi có lỗi trong sơ đồ; nghĩa khác "bank branch" = chi nhánh.
items.explanationEn: branch /bræntʃ/ (noun): a path splitting off in a flow. An "error branch" is the path a flow takes on failure; another sense is a company's local office.

items.question: Trong câu "Open dev tools on a website and read the requests as you interact", từ "interact" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Open dev tools on a website and read the requests as you interact", what does "interact" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interact /ˌɪntərˈækt/ (động từ): tương tác. Danh từ "interaction"; "interact with a website" = thao tác với trang web.
items.explanationEn: interact /ˌɪntərˈækt/ (verb): to act and get responses. Noun: "interaction"; "interact with a website" means using it and seeing it respond.

items.question: Trong câu "Read industry news weekly and note the terms you do not understand", từ "industry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read industry news weekly and note the terms you do not understand", what does "industry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: industry /ˈɪndəstri/ (danh từ): ngành (kinh doanh). "Industry news" = tin tức ngành; nghĩa cũ "industry" = sự cần cù (tính từ "industrious").
items.explanationEn: industry /ˈɪndəstri/ (noun): a field of business. "Industry news" covers a business sector; an older sense is diligence (adjective "industrious").

items.question: Trong câu "Read industry news weekly and note the terms you do not understand", từ "term" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read industry news weekly and note the terms you do not understand", what does "term" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with a specific meaning
items.explanation: term /tɜːrm/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ. Ở đây là thuật ngữ; "terms and conditions" = điều khoản, "term" còn là học kỳ hay nhiệm kỳ.
items.explanationEn: term /tɜːrm/ (noun): a word with a specific meaning. Here it is a word for a concept; "terms and conditions" are contract clauses, and a term can be a semester.

items.question: Trong câu "BA skills are not learned by reading — only by doing and getting feedback.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA skills are not learned by reading — only by doing and getting feedback.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/ (danh từ): nhận xét, góp ý. "Get/give feedback" = nhận/đưa góp ý; là danh từ không đếm được.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/ (noun): comments on your work. "Get/give feedback" is the usual collocation; it is uncountable.

items.question: Trong câu "The fastest way to improve is handing your documentation to someone else for review and genuinely listening to what they did not understand.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fastest way to improve is handing your documentation to someone else for review and genuinely listening to what they did not understand.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thật lòng, thực sự. Tính từ "genuine" = thật, chân thành; "genuinely listen" = lắng nghe thật sự.
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): sincerely, truly. Adjective: "genuine"; "genuinely listen" means really paying attention.

items.question: Trong câu "BA skills split into three tiers: core (indispensable), craft (learnable), contextual (accumulated).", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA skills split into three tiers: core (indispensable), craft (learnable), contextual (accumulated).", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia thành. "Split into" = chia thành nhiều phần; danh từ "split" = sự chia tách.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split into" means divide into parts; the noun "split" is a division.

items.question: Trong câu "Three questions that catch most omissions: what happens if, who else is involved, how do you handle it today.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three questions that catch most omissions: what happens if, who else is involved, how do you handle it today.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əˈmɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều bị bỏ sót. Động từ "omit" = bỏ sót; ba câu hỏi này bắt được phần lớn yêu cầu bị sót.
items.explanationEn: omission /əˈmɪʃn/ (noun): something left out. Verb: "omit"; these three questions catch most missing requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "Verify with data instead of accepting assumptions — run a query rather than trusting a claim.", từ "claim" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Verify with data instead of accepting assumptions — run a query rather than trusting a claim.", what does "claim" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: claim /kleɪm/ (danh từ): lời khẳng định. Ở đây là lời khẳng định; "insurance claim" = yêu cầu bồi thường bảo hiểm.
items.explanationEn: claim /kleɪm/ (noun): an assertion of truth. Here it is an assertion; an "insurance claim" is a demand for payment.

items.question: Trong câu "Inventing a ludicrous but literally compliant reading is the most effective self-check.", từ "effective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inventing a ludicrous but literally compliant reading is the most effective self-check.", what does "effective" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: effective /ɪˈfektɪv/ (tính từ): hiệu quả. "Most effective" = hiệu quả nhất; nghĩa khác "effective from 1 May" = có hiệu lực từ ngày 1/5.
items.explanationEn: effective /ɪˈfektɪv/ (adjective): producing results. "Most effective" means works best; another sense is "effective from 1 May", i.e. in force.

items.question: Trong câu "Just-enough technical knowledge exists to sharpen your questions and reveal hidden work, not to make you a coder.", từ "sharpen" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Just-enough technical knowledge exists to sharpen your questions and reveal hidden work, not to make you a coder.", what does "sharpen" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sharpen /ˈʃɑːrpən/ (động từ): làm sắc bén hơn. Hậu tố "-en" biến tính từ thành động từ: sharp → sharpen; "sharpen your skills" = mài giũa kỹ năng.
items.explanationEn: sharpen /ˈʃɑːrpən/ (verb): to make more precise. The suffix "-en" turns an adjective into a verb: sharp → sharpen; "sharpen your skills" means improve them.

items.question: Trong câu "Just-enough technical knowledge exists to sharpen your questions and reveal hidden work, not to make you a coder.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Just-enough technical knowledge exists to sharpen your questions and reveal hidden work, not to make you a coder.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, tiết lộ. Trái nghĩa "conceal", "hide"; "reveal hidden work" = làm lộ ra khối lượng việc ẩn.
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make visible. Opposite of "conceal" or "hide"; "reveal hidden work" means exposing effort nobody saw.
